layers.name: eyes-beak
layers.purpose: Empty dark pupil cells, fixed highlight, closed-lid line and beak tip.

anchors: Two separated forward-facing eyes with central beak
Rounded perched body with folded wings and two feet
views: Modest left/right head turns, default ±34 degrees, hard cap45; pitch hard cap20; no profile/back

parts.name: head
parts.motion: Bounded yaw/pitch with eyes carried by the head.

parts.name: wings
parts.motion: Two fixed shoulders; independent lag; constant length .69.

phases.name: idle
phases.transition: Seeded gentle local motion until target/react.

phases.name: approach
phases.transition: Head eases toward finite normalized target.

phases.name: stretch
phases.transition: Paired wing extension with six-tick phase offset then recovery.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.transition: React ignored until complete; attention may resume.

motion.replayGuarantee: Same version/config/seed, explicit consecutive ticks and strictly ordered normalized event log => identical state/cells in the tested JS runtime, independent of render grouping. No cross-engine pixel promise. fixtures/replay.json records the actual scenario. State restore unsupported.

interaction.pointer: CSS rectangle normalized to [-1,1], finite values required; motion is attention only. No click reaction on empty background.
interaction.keyboard: Native React, Pause/Play, Reset and Guide select; no global shortcut interception.
interaction.touch: Native >=44px buttons/selects; no hover dependence or touch-action:none. Real touch device acceptance unrun.
interaction.precedence: Last attention/leave wins in ordered batch; at most one react accepted; reaction/recovery/cooldown repeats ignored. Browser coalesces <=2 actions. Pause/reduced/hidden/offscreen/zero-size compose.

accessibility.description: A round-faced owl perched on a branch, with two forward-facing eyes, folded wings and planted feet.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Initial static poster; deliberate Guide/React changes one static pose without ticks/RAF. Pointer cannot override. Live change freezes displayed pose.
accessibility.pause: User pause freezes exact displayed pose and survives reset/options. Scope includes zero-size/offscreen/hidden. Disposal idempotent.
accessibility.liveRegion: Only deliberate control/policy announcements. Glyph block and frame telemetry never continuously announced.
